74.group_script:
to the following
announcement.
This morning, I want to inform everyone
about the changes to our recycling
procedure. Before, we utilized the grey bins
for all paper-made material, such as
newspapers, magazines, and office papers.
Also, we used the blue bins for all other
recyclable products, such as cans, plastic
bottles, and glass containers. From now on,
you will be given brown paper bags for
magazine recycling and yellow plastic bags
for plastic bottles. The modifications we've
made may take a little bit of getting used to,
but I’m sure the color-coded list of
recyclable items we’ve provided will help
you sort things out.

89.group_script:
to the following
interview.
It’s funny you should ask that question,
because as a child growing up near a farm,
I always thought being a farmer was the
coolest thing to be, and I actually was going
to become one. Of course my perspective on
professions changed when I moved to the
city at eighteen. That’s where I discovered
my passion for the stage. But it was tough
getting a part, especially for the first five
years. I must’ve auditioned at least a
hundred times and I couldn’t get even the
smallest role. In retrospect, I didn’t know a
thing about acting during that period. It
sometimes amazes me that the same young
foolish kid who couldn’t buy himself a role
has starred in fifteen Broadway plays.

to the following
introduction.
Good morning, everyone. In preparation for
the upcoming business conference with our
contacts in Miami, we have invited a special
guest to assist us with our presentation
skills. Anton Carter will instruct us on
effective business presentations. More
specifically, he will teach us for the next
three hours about the different types of
business presentations, content factors, the
right kind of language, and delivery
techniques. I should also add that Mr. Carter
has recently been invited to teach a class on
this topic at the University of Western
Rorida. The next three hours are going to be
very demanding, but I hope that you’ll
participate with enthusiasm and try your
best. So, without any more delay, I give you
Mr. Carter.
